items.title: Register with an empty Token box shows "A token is needed to register a webhook." next to the form
covers: Expected: after step 4 the page says, next to the form, that a token is needed to register a webhook
items.reason: This is the bug itself: before the fix, Register with an empty Token box changed nothing on the page. It must run through the browser (e2e) because the defect is what the user sees after a click in a Blazor page; no API or unit layer reaches the rendered message. Kept separate from TC-BUG-52-02 so a missing message and an unwanted registration fail as distinct cases.

items.title: Register with an empty Token box registers no webhook
covers: Implementation Notes: empty token -> no POST
items.reason: The ticket requires that an empty token registers nothing; if the guard were removed, the page could send a subscription with an empty token to the Webhooks API. Checked at e2e because the trigger is the page's form; the page is server-rendered Blazor, so the request would leave the server, not the browser; the outcome is therefore checked in the user's registered-webhooks list on the home page and through the Webhooks API.

items.title: Register with a token registers the webhook and returns to the home page as before
covers: Expected: Register with a token in the box behaves exactly as today
Implementation Notes: token present -> navigate home on success
items.reason: The fix must not change the path with a token: success still registers the `OrderPaid` webhook and navigates home. A regression here (for example the guard firing for a filled box, or a stale message blocking submit) would break the client's only registration flow, which only the browser flow on the test stack exercises end to end (page -> Webhooks API -> grant check against the client's `/check`).

items.title: After the empty-token message, entering a token and registering succeeds
covers: Expected: Register with a token in the box behaves exactly as today
Expected: message for the empty Token box (recovery after it)
items.reason: The new message is state on the page; the ticket requires that Register with a token behaves exactly as today, including right after the user saw the message. If the message state blocked or altered the next submit, the user who follows the message's advice could not register. Only the browser flow shows this sequence.
